chapter: Hometown ties, community and favorite players
title: Best bands of the 1930s: Desvigne and Shadowland
summary: Sidney Desvigne's band and the Shadowland nightclub.

story.theme_name: Gangsters, bootleggers and rough clubs of Prohibition
story.community_name: Cabarets, honky-tonks and the Storyville nightlife scene

blocks.x: Who do you think had the best jazz bands here in town? When?
Now or? Now and then. Well back in those days, Sidney Dazby had the most outstanding band. In the thirties, huh?
I don't know when he went to California, I'm trying to remember. He died over there, you know.
Must have been in the forties when he went to California.
Yeah, cause he was managing the Shadowland right over here.
Where was that? Huh? Where was the Shadowland? I was never.
One was in between Daniele and Dry. Uh huh. That's a big, luxurious nightclub in those days it was. It was still there, but I don't know how it look now, you know. They made a motel out of it.
